title: Information Access and Gain-Loss Framing in Six Large Language Models and Human Decision Makers
abstract: arXiv:2611.28525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A risky choice can be described by what will be saved or what will be lost, and people often choose differently depending on that wording. We test whether six large language models (LLMs) show this gain-loss framing effect, and whether it shrinks when they can first read more about the options. GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3 235B and Llama 4 Maverick made 11,519 choices across four risk scenarios, each in its original wording, two paraphrases and a mirrored version in the opposite wording. Before choosing, a model could open up to 0, 2, 3 or 4 of seven information cards. With no cards, all six models showed large framing effects: the share choosing the safe option was 27 to 79 percentage points lower under loss than under gain wording. The gap was smaller at 2 cards than with no cards in every model. Against a 10-point threshold set in our analysis plan, GPT-4.1 fell within it at 4 cards and Qwen3 only at 2 cards;

translated_title: 六个大型语言模型与人类决策者的信息获取与得失框架效应
translated_abstract: 一个风险选择可以通过描述将会挽救什么或将会失去什么来呈现，而人们往往会因措辞不同而做出不同的选择。我们测试了六个大型语言模型是否表现出这种得失框架效应，以及当它们能够先阅读更多关于选项的信息时，这种效应是否会减弱。GPT-4.1、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3 235B和Llama 4 Maverick在四个风险情景中共做出了11,519次选择，每个情景包括原始措辞、两个改写版本和一个措辞相反的镜像版本。在选择之前，模型可以打开七张信息卡片中的0、2、3或4张。在没有信息卡片的情况下，所有六个模型都表现出较大的框架效应：在损失措辞下选择安全选项的比例比在收益措辞下低27到79个百分点。在所有模型中，打开2张卡片时的差距都比没有卡片时更小。根据分析计划中设定的10个百分点阈值，GPT-4.1在打开4张卡片时降至阈值以内，而Qwen3仅在打开2张卡片时就已达标。
tldr: 六个大型语言模型在信息受限时均表现出显著的类似人类的得失框架效应，而允许其先查阅更多信息卡片能显著减弱该效应，其中GPT-4.1在4张卡片、Qwen3在仅2张卡片时效应降至预设阈值以内。
en_tdlr: Six large language models exhibit substantial human-like gain-loss framing effects under limited information, and accessing additional information cards significantly shrinks this effect, with GPT-4.1 falling within the 10-point threshold at 4 cards and Qwen3 at just 2 cards.
